competency_fulfillment.rationale: Similar fractions are fractions sharing a denominator, such as 2/8, 3/8 and 5/8, yet all five seeds shade exactly '1 part' of 8 and key 1/8, a unit fraction. None of the four representations the competency names - groups of objects, fraction charts, fraction tiles, the number line - appears in any stem.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The wording names four representation modes crossed with six denominators. Seeds 42-46 deliver a single generic 'shape' at denominator 8 with one shaded part, so effectively one narrow slice of the named space is generated and the rest never appears.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: The phrasing 'divided into 8 equal parts' with a single follow-up question is simple enough for Grade 2 Quarter 4 and asks for one count-and-name step, so the reading and reasoning load is age-appropriate even though the target skill is wrong.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: There is no set model with grouped objects, no linear model on a number line, and no chart or tile model. The shaded count is frozen at 1 at every seed, so no non-unit similar fraction such as 3/8 or 5/8 is ever displayed.

competency_alignment.rationale: Nothing progresses toward recognising that 2/6 and 5/6 share a denominator and are therefore similar. The repeated item is the same one served for mat_g2_na_q4_0, so this node contributes no distinct skill development.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: Denominator 8 lies inside the allowed set but is the hardest single option, offered with no easier halves or thirds to anchor it, and the 3/16 distractor exceeds the stated denominator ceiling of 8.
